name: Memory After Death
overview: Scripture reveals a nuanced understanding of memory after death, emphasizing that while the living remember the righteous with blessing, the wicked's name decays and fades away (Proverbs 10:7). Ecclesiastes teaches that the dead no longer have awareness or reward, and their memory is forgotten (Ecclesiastes 9:5), as their spirit returns to God and their body to the earth (Ecclesiastes 12:7). Ultimately, God promises a new creation where former things, including memories, will no longer come to mind (Isaiah 65:17), underscoring the eternal significance of the soul over the body, which can be destroyed in hell (Matthew 10:28).
